question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Now that $ZOE's stepped down, who do you think the next Head Cheerleader should be?
What do you think of the new mascot?
options: How dare you change the mascot?!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now, this week we're officially unveiling the new school and mascot, and I think it'd be a big boost to the school if we held a rally.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: However, if the cheerleaders aren't under your control by then, we won't have one, and I'll end the program before things get completely out of hand!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Mean? $ZOE, whenever we win a football game, you give cupcakes to the team we beat!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't want them to feel bad!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And that's sweet, but a person who gives out pity cupcakes isn't going to get very far by being mean.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So what am I supposed to do?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I guess you'll have to figure it out...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Good. Good. Are you capable of being assertive?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes! Especially in times of crisis. I always seem to rise up...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's how I got on the team in the first place... I went after what I wanted.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And that's the kind of self-confidence I wanted to hear.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: You're going to be a doormat if you can't even speak your mind!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... Sometimes I just freeze up like that...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Well, that is unacceptable for a Head Cheerleader.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am.

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: I like that you girls aren't wearing those uniforms anymore!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: With everyone wearing something different, you all look so... `Alone.`
nodes.text_bbcode: With everyone wearing something different, you all look so... [color=#e23b3b][i]Alone.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Ew! Gross!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I knew it was a bad idea to wear whatever we wanted! Great idea, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry...
The next day, in a dark, goblin dungeon...

nodes.speaker: Brendan
nodes.text: Spinning lion frenzy!

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: Hit! 11 points of damage! Unfortunately, your `roaring` attack echoes throughout the dungeon! Four more goblins arrive!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hit! 11 points of damage! Unfortunately, your [color=#e23b3b][i]roaring[/i][/color] attack echoes throughout the dungeon! Four more goblins arrive!

nodes.text: Next to the nerd table, the cheerleaders stare at $ZOE, waiting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh, on three, I guess. One, two, three!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: { Don't worry! Never fear! Slay those goblins! Hear our cheer! {

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: { You're in a corner, nerves a'plenty! {

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: { That's okay! Roll a twenty! {
Dex tosses his character sheet into the air!

nodes.speaker: Dex
nodes.text: I can't concentrate with all this incessant cheering!

nodes.speaker: Angie
nodes.text: It is `really` distracting...
nodes.text_bbcode: It is [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] distracting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You don't like us here?

nodes.speaker: Andrew
nodes.text: No! You're ruining Ogres 'N' Elves!
In Auto Shop, Megan is welding two motorcycle parts together. Behind her, the cheerleaders gather...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Just like we practiced... One, two, three!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: { Weld! Weld! {

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: { Weld! Weld! {

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: { `Weeeeeeeeeld!` {
nodes.text_bbcode: { [color=#3b78e2][i]Weeeeeeeeeld![/i][/color] {

nodes.text: Megan snarls, lifting her welding hood up!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: First, you're not helping!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: And second, you couldn't come up with anything more creative?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We tried... But we don't know anything about cars!

nodes.speaker: Megan
nodes.text: Get out!

nodes.speaker: Ryan
nodes.text: Or stay... I'm cool with you staying!
Zoe has failed...

menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Did you hear that? $ZOE approves!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: We'll cheer wherever we want!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! Let's go to Jamaica!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait...
The cheerleaders head off into the locker room before $ZOE can stop them.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This sounds like a bad idea...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But at least I'm not acting mean like Jessica did...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: How could you say something like that?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, okay! I know I said that there aren't any bad ideas in a brainstorm, but cheering everywhere is ridiculous, Keith!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: You don't have to be so mean about it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm beginning to think that maybe I do! And since I'm not a mean person...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I quit!
The cheerleaders gasp!
Before $ZOE can even consider the ramifications of what she's done...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yay! I'll be new Head Cheerleader!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda, are you sure...?
Amanda runs out in front of the other cheerleaders...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yaaaay! Everyone wears a mascot suit! New cheer formation... A big tower of girls!
The girls try to form a huge tower...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Never mind! Let's go cheer for seagulls!
Confused, the other cheerleaders follow Amanda toward the exit...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: You have to skip, or you're off the team!
The cheerleaders skip out, leaving $ZOE all by herself, alone...
It's clear...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You mean, we'll actually be `comfortable.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You mean, we'll actually be [color=#3b78e2][i]comfortable.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sweet! I was getting sick of wearing this thing! What's it made out of anyway? Sandpaper?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, and cat tongues!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: You guys are seriously gross!
$ZOE starts handing out the old cheerleader uniforms!
After everyone changes...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I forgot just `how` comfortable these were!
nodes.text_bbcode: I forgot just [color=#3b78e2][i]how[/i][/color] comfortable these were!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I know! It's like wearing pajamas!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Looks like I made the right call...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Go get changed, everyone! Meet back out here in ten minutes!
Ten minutes later...
The cheerleaders are standing in front of $ZOE in a mish-mash of outfits...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whenever I wear bright spandex, I feel right at home!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nicole, are you wearing a bikini?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Am I the only one who thought Jessica's uniforms were way conservative?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Not at all!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Maybe this was a bad idea...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: All right! Now that we got that out of the way, let's get started!
The cheerleaders robotically get into pyramid formation...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Wait! Pyramids create strife between those on the top and those on the bottom! It's `archaic!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Wait! Pyramids create strife between those on the top and those on the bottom! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]archaic![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah! It's `our cake!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah! It's [color=#3b78e2][i]our cake![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: So let's get in a new shape!
The cheerleaders gasp!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What kind of shape?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How about a straight line?
The cheerleaders giddily form a straight line.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: This is way better than the pyramid! I can actually see what's going on!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, and I don't have 800 pounds on my back!
The girls glare at Keith.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: 400 pounds?
Hector covers Keith's mouth.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What Keith meant to say is he's happy he's not on the bottom anymore.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm glad you guys are so amenable to all my changes!
Later, at the end of practice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And... Done!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: This is so much fun!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: It's nice to practice without any pressure from Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Remember the cupcakes?! Squee! Best practice ever!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hopefully, just the first of many!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I had one more item on my agenda before we wrap it up for the day... I wanted to get together...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: To rank hot guys?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee... No, we'll do that later, I promise. But for now, I want to huddle up and have a brainstorm!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Brainstorm? That sounds painful!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, it won't be, Amanda... Let's discuss different ways we can improve cheerleading! This is the chance for your voice to be heard!
The cheerleaders look blankly at one another...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on! I know you've all thought about how to make cheerleading better! Feel free to share!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Well, we could probably develop some creative cheers instead of repeating old ones.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: We could try to get our parents to help us out with fundraising campaigns.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I like it!
For a moment, the brainstorm seems to stall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Remember, there are no bad ideas in a brainstorm!
Amanda raises her hand!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Tiger petting zoo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's... Uh... Interesting.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for contributing, Amanda!
As soon as $ZOE validates Amanda's idea, the cheerleaders begin to chatter with excitement... Ideas pour out of them!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: The next time it rains, let's make a big pool of mud, and just dance in it! It'll be so raw!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... That sounds... Wrong.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I think if I got shot out of a cannon I could do, like, thirty or forty flips in the air!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That... Uh... That might be dangerous...

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: More importantly, why are we only cheering for `sports?!` Other people need encouragement too! We should cheer for everything!
nodes.text_bbcode: More importantly, why are we only cheering for [color=#e23b3b][i]sports?![/i][/color] Other people need encouragement too! We should cheer for everything!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I love it!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: What do you say, $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm going to discard a lot of cheerleader traditions, so hopefully I'll be taking meanness out of the equation altogether!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's that sad face again...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I just want you to be careful making changes so quickly, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: When I became captain of the football team, I thought I could change things too...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I wanted everyone to have a chance to play whatever position they wanted.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What happened?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: It wasn't pretty... We had fifty guys trying to play quarterback...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ever seen an offensive lineman try a five-step drop?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that a dance move?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: What? Oh... Right. Forgot who I was talking to.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I appreciate you warning me, Howard... But I'm not trying to change a bunch of hot-headed football players...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: These are `cheerleaders...` They're supposed to be flexible!
nodes.text_bbcode: These are [color=#3b78e2][i]cheerleaders...[/i][/color] They're supposed to be flexible!

nodes.text: Later, at practice... $ZOE stands in front of the cheerleading team, a huge smile spread across her face!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Welcome to the very first practice `without` Jessica!
nodes.text_bbcode: Welcome to the very first practice [color=#3b78e2][i]without[/i][/color] Jessica!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders cheer!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: All right! No Jessica!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Whatever...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll miss Jessica! She was nice!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Manda-Panda...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yes?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: ...Sigh. Never mind.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Okay!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Wait... Isn't this the second practice? We had a half practice on Father's Day, remember?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Good point, Keith. Welcome to the first `full` practice!
nodes.text_bbcode: Good point, Keith. Welcome to the first [color=#3b78e2][i]full[/i][/color] practice!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And to start things off right... I brought cupcakes for everyone!
$ZOE sets a tray of chocolate frosted cupcakes out on a bench... The cheerleaders eye them suspiciously...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What are those?

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Temptations!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I... I can smell the sugar!
No one makes a move toward the cupcakes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You guys, this isn't a trap. As long as I'm Head Cheerleader, you can eat whatever you want! Dig in!
$ZOE steps aside, and the cheerleaders descend upon the cupcakes, wolfing them down!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: These taste just like my mom's!

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: I love my life!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yum! Goodbye, cupcakes! I'll miss you most of all!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: $ZOE, you're the best!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks! I was also thinking instead of wearing the trashy uniforms Jessica gave us, we could start wearing...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Are you kidding? You cry for the villain in `every` movie we see!
nodes.text_bbcode: Are you kidding? You cry for the villain in [color=#e23b3b][i]every[/i][/color] movie we see!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: They have families too!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: You sign your name with `three` hearts!
nodes.text_bbcode: You sign your name with [color=#e23b3b][i]three[/i][/color] hearts!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's a habit!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Your car has a bumper sticker that says 'I'd kill with kindness, but I'm too nice for that!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee! It's funny!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It doesn't make me look pro-murder, right?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: The point is... I'm not worried about you becoming mean... Because that's impossible...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, I'm a little hurt you'd even suggest that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Actually, I am.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? Howard, you're supposed to support me!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: I know, and I do, but I'm just not sure that you're... Well, mean enough.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can be mean...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Really? Say something mean about someone.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay... You're on! Just tell me who, and I'll do it.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Ummmm, I'll give you an easy one... `Ryan.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Ummmm, I'll give you an easy one... [color=#e23b3b][i]Ryan.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's easy... He, uh, he has a gap between his teeth.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That is a fact, not a burn.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: He likes girls! A lot!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: That could easily be a compliment...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Fine! Fine! He's really slimy...
The word 'slimy' hangs there for a second or two, but $ZOE can't handle it.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: ...But `only` if you're unable to see his softer, kinder, more sensitive side!
nodes.text_bbcode: ...But [color=#3b78e2][i]only[/i][/color] if you're unable to see his softer, kinder, more sensitive side!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: See what I mean? You're a nice person.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that such a bad thing?

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Not at all. I love you, $ZOE. I love you `because` you're this nice.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not at all. I love you, $ZOE. I love you [color=#e23b3b][i]because[/i][/color] you're this nice.

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I know... I love you too.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: And hey, I think your capable of `becoming` a good Head Cheerleader...
nodes.text_bbcode: And hey, I think your capable of [color=#e23b3b][i]becoming[/i][/color] a good Head Cheerleader...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I love puppies just as much as the next girl, but puppies are fragile, Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: If we did a routine with a bunch of puppies around us, there's a chance we could hurt them...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Oh no! I wouldn't want that...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Plus, who's going to take care of the puppies? Who's going to look after them?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I guess I hadn't thought about all the ramifications...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't be discouraged. I like your ideas. Keep contributing.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aaaaaand... `Scene!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aaaaaand... [color=#3b78e2][i]Scene![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I think you've got it, $ZOE!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That `was` easy!
nodes.text_bbcode: That [color=#3b78e2][i]was[/i][/color] easy!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Um... Are you okay?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: No! I can't believe you don't like my idea!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Taylor! I'm not a puppy hater! I didn't mean it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: So we can try out my idea?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Of course we can! Whatever makes this okay!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Aaaaaand... `Fail!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Aaaaaand... [color=#3b78e2][i]Fail![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: You can't be a pushover, $ZOE! You got completely caught up in the emotions of the moment!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I did...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know much about you, Maria...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We should totally hang out more!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I'd like that.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks for the advice!
The next morning, $ZOE finds Taylor just outside the mobile classrooms...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Taylor, can I talk to you?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I figured I might see you sometime soon...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You did? Why?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Uh, hello? Could you make worse Head Cheerleader decisions? Dietary freedom? Brainstorms? What's next? No pyramid?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Actually, I got rid of the pyramid for a... A straight line...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What?! Are you insane?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I messed up, okay! Now I need your help!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: My help?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You know what it's like to be a Head Cheerleader... If anyone could help me out, it's you.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: That's true... You are in a pretty lonely spot without me.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Have you tried being less `$ZOE` and more assertive?
nodes.text_bbcode: Have you tried being less [color=#3b78e2][i]$ZOE[/i][/color] and more assertive?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I tried that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, that's good... How'd that go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I got what I wanted, but now the cheerleaders hate me for it!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why would anyone hate me?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohhhh, I get it. I see what's going on. You're too nice to make tough choices...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone keeps telling me that.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: As a leader, you have to be comfortable with your decisions, even if they aren't popular.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I do that `all` the time in Ogres 'N' Elves...
nodes.text_bbcode: I do that [color=#3b78e2][i]all[/i][/color] the time in Ogres 'N' Elves...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll be like, 'Erik, we `are` not stopping at `every` inn!'
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll be like, 'Erik, we [color=#3b78e2][i]are[/i][/color] not stopping at [color=#3b78e2][i]every[/i][/color] inn!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't you feel bad after?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: A little, but I've learned how to focus less on the feelings I've hurt and more on all the positive results that will come later.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whenever I make a tough choice, all I can think about are the feelings I've hurt. How do you focus on anything else?

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Well, with Erik, I think about how important it is that we move on. `Every` time we stop at an inn he has Andrew explain every little detail of it!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, with Erik, I think about how important it is that we move on. [color=#3b78e2][i]Every[/i][/color] time we stop at an inn he has Andrew explain every little detail of it!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: What kind of architecture, the history, how the mead's been fermenting...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww, that's cute.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: It's obnoxious! We're adventurers, not tourists in the Museum of Boredom!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can see how that might get annoying...

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Right? As soon as I remind myself just how annoying it is, I feel better about disciplining Erik. It's easy. Now you try.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: I'll pretend that I want something from you. You turn me down. Then as soon as you start to feel bad for me, try to concentrate on why it's a good decision.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay! Let's try it!
Taylor closes her eyes, getting into character. She opens them.

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: $ZOE, I think it'd be `so` cool if we did our routines, like, surrounded by puppies!
nodes.text_bbcode: $ZOE, I think it'd be [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] cool if we did our routines, like, surrounded by puppies!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: We can't do that. It's not a good idea!

nodes.speaker: Taylor
nodes.text: Ohmygosh! I can't believe it! $ZOE hates puppies!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I just need to focus on why it's a good decision...

nodes.prompt: Why is it a good decision?
nodes.title: Make your choice!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You've always been a good listener, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee. Who do you think I should talk to?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: My grandfather always says, 'If you break your foot, don't go to the dentist.'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: It means when you need help, you should always find the right expert. And we both know who the expert on cheerleading is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You mean... Taylor?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Bingo.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: Uh... I'm glad you liked my story, but that isn't why I told it to you.

nodes.text: Oh...

nodes.text: And you should tell your problems to someone who can help you, someone like Taylor.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Ohhhhh... Yeah, that makes more sense.

nodes.text: Sometimes I wonder if you ever listen to me.

As practice wraps up, $ZOE turns to the cheerleaders...
And sees them all glaring at her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Nothing.

nodes.speaker: Keith
nodes.text: Yeah, nothing.

nodes.speaker: Jill

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Jill!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: After that first practice, we thought this was going to be `our` cheerleading team.
nodes.text_bbcode: After that first practice, we thought this was going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] cheerleading team.

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: But it's pretty clear after today's practice that the power's gotten to you, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I didn't get to do the stunt I wanted, Erik's still wearing the lizard suit, and you rejected Hector's music idea!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You guys, someone has to lead!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I guess we know who that is now, don't we?
The cheerleaders angrily walk off to the locker room...
Later, after the cheerleaders have left...
Maria hangs back to talk to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Maria... Are you going to tell me how I'm the bad guy too?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: No, I'm not like that... You know, when I was in grade school, I got picked on a lot because some of the kids found out my middle name.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is your middle name?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Santa... I'm Maria Santa Gonzalez.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: The kids would call me Maria Claus... It drove me crazy. And once they saw that it bothered me, they never let up.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: I never told anyone because I thought they were also making fun of my family... I thought if I told my mother, she'd feel just as bad as I did.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww... I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: One day, when I came home from a particularly bad day, I just broke down and told her...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What'd she say?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: She told me that it was a special moment in my life to get made fun of for my name, because all my older brothers and sisters had gone through the same thing.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: All I had to do was turn it on its head. The next day, I came into school dressed like Santa Claus, and I gave all the kids gifts.

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: After that, I was cool.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's a good story...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: You know why I told you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: No one will be able to get the message if it's dubbed out... I'm sorry, but I just don't think it's a good idea.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, I get it!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Everyone's ideas are great... Unless they're a guy's!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Come on, it's not like that...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Sure it isn't. Let's just dance to girly pop music... Again!
Hector angrily walks away from $ZOE...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I've heard the `No-Pants Society` before... They're intense.
nodes.text_bbcode: I've heard the [color=#3b78e2][i]No-Pants Society[/i][/color] before... They're intense.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm just not sure if society can handle all their, um, sickly beats and tight flowers...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Total slang fail aside... You're probably right. Whenever I play them, my uncle's always like, 'Turn that racket off! It's blocking my chakras!'

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You see?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess... Thanks for at least considering my idea...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: No problem...
Later in practice...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Let's work on our dance for the rally!
A pop song plays through the speakers. Hector steps out of the line of cheerleaders, and pulls $ZOE aside...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: All right, $ZOE, check it...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Ever since we had that brainstorm, my noggin's been running extra laps.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh huh...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: We're always doing these dances, right? But the dances are always set to, well... To super girly music.

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: What if we kicked off the new school with something edgy? What if we set the rally dance to...
Hector whips out a CD with a trio of guys in shades on the cover!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: `The No-Pants Society?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]The No-Pants Society?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Hector

nodes.text: What's there to know? Their beats are sick, their flows are tight, and every song comes with `a powerful message!`

nodes.text: I've been wearing it for a while now, and I don't think I'm a better cheerleader at all... You know what I think?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What?

nodes.text: I think wearing this suit is just a job no one else wants...
Erik sadly shoves his head inside the giant Lyle head and walks away...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't think that went as well as it could have...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Really? You think so?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I do...

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: I `was` picking up on some feminine vibes! WoooOOOOOoooob!
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]was[/i][/color] picking up on some feminine vibes! WoooOOOOOoooob!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Did you just make the sound of feminine vibes?

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, that's the sound I wish they made. If they were audible, dating would sure be a whole heck of a lot easier!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Thanks, $ZOE! I feel like a brand new lizard!
Erik happily puts his head inside the giant Lyle head and skips off!

nodes.text: Flattery always goes further than I expect it to!

nodes.text: I was thinking since we get to wear whatever we want, maybe I could wear something other than the Lyle the Lizard suit!

nodes.text: Awww... Does that mean no fire?

nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] the Head Cheerleader! What I say goes!

nodes.text: But you said that there weren't any bad ideas!

nodes.text_bbcode: In a brainstorm! There aren't any bad ideas [color=#3b78e2][i]in a brainstorm![/i][/color] But we're not in a brainstorm now...

nodes.text: There are plenty of bad ideas... And throwing Jill through a flaming hoop is one `for sure!`
nodes.text_bbcode: There are plenty of bad ideas... And throwing Jill through a flaming hoop is one [color=#3b78e2][i]for sure![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: I guess you're right. A lot could go wrong.

nodes.speaker: Maria

nodes.text_bbcode: But, hey, that doesn't mean we can't do other cool stunts! After all, we [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] a trampoline!

nodes.text: Put me down! I didn't realize our new Head Cheerleader was a grade school tattletale!

nodes.text: If I don't get more aggressive, Shapiro will cancel cheerleading!

Jill interrupts her.

nodes.speaker: Amanda

nodes.text: Um...

nodes.text: Now I just need one of you to toss me through it!

nodes.text_bbcode: Awesome! I [color=#3b78e2][i]love[/i][/color] fire!

nodes.text: Why not?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Because...

nodes.text: Come on, everyone...
After school, the cheerleaders hide near Matteo's scooter...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: He's coming!
When Matteo nears, they jump out of their hiding spot!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: Yah! Pretty scooter thieves! Wait... What is this?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's your personal cheer! One, two, three!

nodes.text: { Did you have a tough day? Don't worry, that's okay! {

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Girls?
$ZOE looks back at the cheerleaders. They're gathered around Jill. She's on the ground, holding her stomach and groaning...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: Unnh! So much food!

nodes.text: Actually, my stomach's been upset all day too...

nodes.text: Blech. I ate two pizzas `today...` $ZOE, can we stop cheering for a while? I think it's bad for our health.
nodes.text_bbcode: Blech. I ate two pizzas [color=#e23b3b][i]today...[/i][/color] $ZOE, can we stop cheering for a while? I think it's bad for our health.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh oh! I think my new 'No Diet' diet might be at fault here... The cheerleaders aren't able to regulate themselves!

nodes.speaker: Matteo
nodes.text: May I please drive my vehicle away?
Just then, $ZOE feels a tapping on her shoulder... She turns to face...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: In my office, right now!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yes, ma'am!
A few moments later, in the principal's office...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What is it, Principal Shapiro?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I'm very concerned.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Cheerleading is a long-standing institution, $ZOE. I've seen more shifts in power than you can count.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Every once in a while, a sweet, nice girl like you takes over... And every time it's the same thing...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: The sweet, nice girl tries to turn cheerleading into a democracy, and the other cheerleaders walk all over her!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But the girls haven't been walking all over me!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: They haven't?! This morning, I got called into Mr. Russell's class... The girls were doing backflips for Phil just because he lit his own Bunsen burner!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And this kind of disruption is just the tip of the iceberg... The nurse's office has been a revolving door of cheerleaders with upset stomachs!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: This is a warning, $ZOE... If you don't figure out a way to establish order, `I will cancel cheerleading!`
nodes.text_bbcode: This is a warning, $ZOE... If you don't figure out a way to establish order, [color=#3b78e2][i]I will cancel cheerleading![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What? You can't do that!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I can't? Dear, I'm the principal. I can do whatever I want!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But that's so unfair! Cheerleading is important! It boosts team spirit!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Then you're going to have to do something about it, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I guess so...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Now tell me what you're going to do to get those girls under your control.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm... I'm going to be...

nodes.text: It's not that I don't like the Lizard suit... I love it! Every time I put this scaly suit on, my blood tingles with school pride, team spirit, and lizard energies!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: But it's hotter than a hot dog on Sunday in this thing, and I have notoriously sweaty glands!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Erik's so sweet... But if I let him start wearing something else, he'll never wear the mascot suit again.

nodes.text: Well, the rally is today... Do you think you'll be ready?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I hope so...
At the big rally, Principal Shapiro stands onstage behind a podium in front of the school...

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I welcome you all to this monumental event.
The audience claps.

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Two months ago, our school was rocked by an earthquake. Fortunately, no one was killed, and nearly everyone escaped unharmed...
As Principal Shapiro speaks, the cheerleaders gather near the stage...

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Where's $ZOE? We're about to go on!

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I haven't seen her...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: There she is!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Why does she look so scary?!
$ZOE leaps onto the stage, storms across, and slams a stereo onto a nearby bench!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: This is boring, Principal Whatever Your Name Is!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Excuse me?
$ZOE wrests the microphone away from Shapiro.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Everyone, listen up! Since none of you will respond to me when I'm nice, I've realized that nice is for suckers! From now on, we're going to do things `my` way!
nodes.text_bbcode: Everyone, listen up! Since none of you will respond to me when I'm nice, I've realized that nice is for suckers! From now on, we're going to do things [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] way!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Uh... $ZOE?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Duh! Yes, it's me! Is something surprising, Maria?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: You just seem so...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Was I talking to you, Hector?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: Angry...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nerds! Light some fireworks!
Pyrotechnics light the stage! $ZOE plays some music on the stereo...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Audience! Start dancing!
No one moves...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Dance, or I'll make you dance!
The audience hesitantly begins to dance...
$ZOE dances on a nearby table!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Whoo! Party! All right!
She sees the cheerleaders standing still onstage.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you doing? Get into the pyramid now! Hector on the bottom!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: What happened to the line?!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those days are over with...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: `Totes` over with!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Totes[/i][/color] over with!

nodes.text: The cheerleaders begrudgingly get into pyramid formation...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is Jessica back but in $ZOE's body?

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: I think so, Amanda...
Months later...
$ZOE hands out flyers to students as they walk down the hall...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hiiiii! Come to Howard's Inauguration tonight! It's going to be `totes` epic!
nodes.text_bbcode: Hiiiii! Come to Howard's Inauguration tonight! It's going to be [color=#3b78e2][i]totes[/i][/color] epic!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Attendance `is` mandatory, so if you don't come...
nodes.text_bbcode: Attendance [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] mandatory, so if you don't come...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'll be `super` disappointed!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'll be [color=#3b78e2][i]super[/i][/color] disappointed!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: How did you get Howard to be President of the high school when he's in college?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Don't ask stupid questions, Maria! There's still some room at the bottom of the pyramid!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Hector
nodes.text: $ZOE, why are you doing this? You're not like this!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I am `now,` Hector! It's the only way to be Head Cheerleader...
nodes.text_bbcode: I am [color=#3b78e2][i]now,[/i][/color] Hector! It's the only way to be Head Cheerleader...

nodes.text: Now if you'll excuse me...

nodes.text: I really like the new $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text: Behind me is the new school, redone in the image of the old one, but with a few minor tweaks...

nodes.text: After school one day, $ZOE and Howard walk together toward the gym...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Eeeep! Howard, I'm so excited for cheer practice! It's the only thing I've been thinking about all day!

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: No kidding...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Why do you say that?
Earlier that day...

nodes.text: Finally! Finally! Finally!

nodes.text: Jessica's gone, and I'm Head Cheerleader! That means no more girl politics! No more drama! Gasp! No more `laundry` duty!

nodes.text: Okay, so maybe I'm obvious! But do you understand how great practice is going to be? It'll be like being hugged by the sun!
